import pytest
from datetime import date, timedelta
from late_fee_calculator import LateFeeCalculator


class TestLateFeeCalculatorInit:
    def test_default_today_uses_date_today(self):
        calc = LateFeeCalculator()

class TestWeekdayDaysBetween:
    def test_end_before_start_returns_zero(self):
        calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2025, 1, 20))
        result = calc._weekday_days_between(date(2025, 1, 20), date(2025, 1, 10))
        assert result == 0

    def test_end_equal_start_returns_zero(self):
        calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2025, 1, 20))
        result = calc._weekday_days_between(date(2025, 1, 20), date(2025, 1, 20))
        assert result == 0

    def test_single_weekday(self):
        # Monday to Tuesday = 1 weekday (Monday)
        calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2025, 1, 7))
        # Jan 6, 2025 is Monday; Jan 7, 2025 is Tuesday
        result = calc._weekday_days_between(date(2025, 1, 6), date(2025, 1, 7))
        assert result == 1

    def test_single_weekend_day(self):
        # Saturday to Sunday = 0 weekdays
        # Jan 4, 2025 is Saturday; Jan 5, 2025 is Sunday
        calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2025, 1, 5))
        result = calc._weekday_days_between(date(2025, 1, 4), date(2025, 1, 5))
        assert result == 0

    def test_full_week_monday_to_monday(self):
        # Monday Jan 6 to Monday Jan 13 = 5 weekdays (Mon-Fri)
        calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2025, 1, 13))
        result = calc._weekday_days_between(date(2025, 1, 6), date(2025, 1, 13))
        assert result == 5

    def test_spans_weekend(self):
        # Friday Jan 3 to Monday Jan 6 = 1 weekday (Friday only; Sat/Sun excluded)
        calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2025, 1, 6))
        result = calc._weekday_days_between(date(2025, 1, 3), date(2025, 1, 6))
        assert result == 1

    def test_two_weeks(self):
        # Two full work weeks = 10 weekdays
        calc = LateFeeCalculator(today=date(2025, 1, 20))
        result = calc._weekday_days_between(date(2025, 1, 6), date(2025, 1, 20))
        assert result == 10
